name: qUSmacro10
title: US macroeconomic data: Heaps subset with 10 variables
description: US macroeconomic data described in Koop (2013), using the source files and preprocessing supplied by Heaps (2023). Monthly series are averaged into quarters; the combined series are transformed using the supplied log/differencing codes and standardized. Standardized quarterly US macroeconomic observations with 10 variables, fixed VAR order p = 4. Stan input contains observations and dimensions; fixed prior hyperparameters are defined in the model.
